name: Silence

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: 20-foot sphere has no sound, Deafened occupants and Thunder immunity; Verbal spells impossible within it; sound cannot cross; Concentration with ritual option.

rules.text: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range.
Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere has Immunity to Thunder damage, and creatures have the Deafened condition while entirely inside it.
Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.
